modules.title: Introduction to Life and Teachings of Jesus
modules.html:
The birth, baptism and temptation of Jesus; his parables, miracles and the Sermon on the Mount. This section covers introduction to life and teachings of jesus.

Key points

  • Jesus was born in Bethlehem during the reign of King _____. — Herod the Great.
  • The forerunner of Jesus was _____. — John the Baptist.
  • Jesus was baptized in River _____. — Jordan.
  • In the temptation of Jesus, the devil asked Him to turn stones into bread to test His _____. — humanity/sonship.
  • The first four disciples called by Jesus were _____. — fishermen.

Worked examples

Q: Jesus was born in Bethlehem during the reign of King _____.
A: Herod the Great — Herod the Great was the King of Judea at the time of Jesus' birth and ordered the massacre of the innocents.

Q: The forerunner of Jesus was _____.
A: John the Baptist — John the Baptist was sent to 'prepare the way of the Lord' and preach repentance.

examples.q: Jesus was born in Bethlehem during the reign of King _____.

quiz.q: Jesus was born in Bethlehem during the reign of King _____.
quiz.solution: Herod the Great was the King of Judea at the time of Jesus' birth and ordered the massacre of the innocents.

quiz.q: The forerunner of Jesus was _____.
quiz.solution: John the Baptist was sent to 'prepare the way of the Lord' and preach repentance.

quiz.q: Jesus was baptized in River _____.
quiz.solution: John the Baptist baptized Jesus in the Jordan River to 'fulfill all righteousness'.

quiz.q: In the temptation of Jesus, the devil asked Him to turn stones into bread to test His _____.
quiz.solution: The temptation 'If you are the Son of God...' was an attempt to make Jesus use His divine power for selfish physical needs.

quiz.q: The first four disciples called by Jesus were _____.
quiz.solution: Peter, Andrew, James, and John were all fishermen at the Sea of Galilee.

quiz.q: Jesus' triumphal entry into Jerusalem was on a _____.
quiz.solution: Riding a donkey fulfilled the prophecy of Zechariah 9:9 and symbolized Jesus as a Prince of Peace, not a war-lord.

quiz.q: Jesus was crucified at a place called Golgotha, which means _____.
quiz.solution: Golgotha is an Aramaic word meaning 'Skull', referring to the shape of the hill or its use as a site for executions.

quiz.q: In the Sermon on the Mount, Jesus called his followers the _____ of the earth.
quiz.solution: Jesus used 'salt' and 'light' to describe the transformative influence Christians should have on society.

quiz.q: The 'Great Commandment' according to Jesus is to love _____.
quiz.solution: Jesus taught that loving God with all one's heart, soul, and mind is the first and greatest commandment.

quiz.q: The name 'Peter' given to Simon by Jesus means _____.
quiz.solution: Jesus called him 'Petros' (rock) and said upon this rock He would build His church.

quiz.q: Jesus healed a man born blind by using _____.
quiz.solution: John 9 records that Jesus spat on the ground, made mud with the saliva, and put it on the man's eyes.

quiz.q: Jesus was born in a _____.
quiz.solution: Because there was no room in the inn, Mary laid the baby Jesus in a manger.

quiz.q: According to the Gospel of Luke, the angel who announced the birth of Jesus to Mary was _____.
quiz.solution: Luke 1:26 states that the angel Gabriel was sent from God to a city in Galilee named Nazareth.

quiz.q: In the Sermon on the Mount, Jesus taught that the _____ shall inherit the earth.
quiz.solution: Matthew 5:5 (The Beatitudes) states: 'Blessed are the meek, for they shall inherit the earth'.

quiz.q: The garden where Jesus prayed in agony before His arrest was _____.
quiz.solution: Gethsemane, located on the Mount of Olives, was the site where Jesus asked that 'this cup' might pass from Him.

quiz.q: The Roman Centurion who sought Jesus to heal his servant showed great _____.
quiz.solution: Jesus marveled at the Centurion's faith, saying He had not found such great faith even in Israel.
